verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas documents programmatic automation: an Editor API for automating scene and asset tasks, an official MCP server 'for AI automation of the PlayCanvas Editor', and REST API access on paid plans. However, the MCP server works against an open Editor session, so the evidence shows interactive, agent-driven automation rather than unattended background jobs. Missing for 10: scheduled, triggered or background automation runs, any autonomous execution without an open Editor session, and independent hands-on corroboration.
